worldcombat.skill.hydropump.summary: Holds a short, fierce high-pressure column of water on a locked line: the direction locks at release, the column runs from the muzzle to the real blocking point each tick, drenches the first foe in front once and then shoves it back step by step. The deluge form splashes a small ring at the point it actually stops; visible foes inside take one backwash and are doused, and a foe that shrugs off the damage is never doused or pushed.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.0: Douse and shove back the target blocking the way ahead
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.1: Push the foe guarding a corridor out of its mouth
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.2: Douse first, then let another move (e.g. Hydro Cannon) cash in on it
The column holds its line for 6 ticks; the first valid foe in front takes a single %1$s special damage hit, never once per tick.
The column has a %1$s block hit radius and it reaches %2$s blocks; the whole direction is fixed at release and scatters by up to ±%3$s, less the higher the Sp. Atk.

On a hit it shoves that target about %1$s blocks total along the column (split across the 6 ticks, limited by real blocking) and douses it for about %2$s; while doused its movement speed is reduced by 12%, ending when the effect expires.

The deluge form splashes once at the point the column really stops (a wall or a body): other foes within %2$s blocks that can see the endpoint take about %1$s backwash damage, and only those that actually lose health are shoved away and doused (for about seven tenths as long as the main target). The pressure form produces no backwash.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.deluge.on: Deluge form: backwash radius x1.5, backwash power x1.2, dousing x1.25 and scatter x1.4; costs torrent power x0.82, flow speed x0.9, range -2 blocks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.deluge.off: Pressure form: torrent power x1.08, push x1.15, a tighter line and flow speed x1.05; costs backwash radius x0.85, and there is no backwash.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.growth.0: From level %1$s the torrent power rises to %2$s and the backwash radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.growth.1: From level %1$s the torrent power rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and the dousing to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.preference.d: On: backwash radius x1.5, backwash power x1.2, dousing x1.25 and scatter x1.4, for drenching the ring around the stopping point; costs torrent power x0.82, flow speed x0.9, range -2 blocks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (pressure form): power x1.08, push x1.15 and a tighter line, at the cost of backwash radius x0.85 with no backwash at all, shoving only what stands ahead.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target below three tenths health ranks lower, saving the heavy shot for something that can take it instead of wasting PP on a dying foe; off: finish low-health targets with it.
